text.id: Tempat Sri Rejeki biasanya bersandar kosong. Cuma ban bekasnya yang ketinggalan, masih diiket ke tiang, ngambang sendirian.
text.en: The Sri Rejeki's berth is empty. Only its old tire is left, still tied to the post, floating on its own.

text.id: Di warung kopi, dua laki-laki pake kaos polo biru dongker lagi ngobrol sama bapak pemilik warung. Di dada kaosnya ada logo kecil. Ombak di bawah matahari terbit. "BPM".
text.en: At the coffee stall, two men in navy polo shirts are talking to the owner. There's a small logo on their chests. A wave under a rising sun. "BPM".

text.id: Duduk di ujung bangku warung, pura-pura main HP, dengerin.
text.en: Sit at the end of the stall's bench, pretend to look at your phone, listen.

text.id: "Sri Rejeki baliknya jam berapa, Pak?" tanya yang lebih tinggi. "Senin malem minggu lalu, ada yang naik nggak? Cewek, pake headphone?"
text.en: "What time does the Sri Rejeki come back?" asks the taller one. "Monday night last week, did anyone go out on it? A girl, with headphones?"

text.id: Bapak warung ngelap gelas lama banget. "Kapal mah banyak, Pak. Cewek juga banyak."
text.en: The stall owner takes a long time wiping a glass. "Lots of boats, sir. Lots of girls too."

text.id: Yang pendek nengok ke gue. Lama. Bapak warung naruh kopi di depan gue tanpa gue pesen. "Ponakan saya. Kerjanya main HP doang." Mereka ketawa. Gue juga, telat sedetik.
text.en: The shorter one looks at me. A long look. The owner sets a coffee in front of me that I never ordered. "My nephew. All he does is play on his phone." They laugh. So do I, a second too late.

text.id: Gue muter lewat belakang krat-krat ikan. Bau amisnya nempel lagi di baju. Kali ini gue bersyukur.
text.en: I go the long way round, behind the fish crates. The smell gets into my clothes again. This time I'm grateful for it.

text.id: Tadi pagi Bu Wulan nyelipin kertas ke tangan gue di pintu. Bekas struk belanja. Di baliknya, tulisan tangannya. "Pak Karta. Gg. Kerapu 3, Kamal Muara. Rumah cat kuning."
text.en: This morning Mrs. Wulan slipped a piece of paper into my hand at the door. An old shopping receipt. On the back, in her handwriting. "Pak Karta. Gg. Kerapu 3, Kamal Muara. Yellow house."

text.id: Bu Rohmah, ibu pengupas kerang, ngasih tahu alamatnya sambil tetep ngupas. "Kamal Muara. Gang Kerapu, yang catnya kuning. Bilang aja dari saya."
text.en: Bu Rohmah, the mussel woman, gives me the address without stopping her shelling. "Kamal Muara. Gang Kerapu, the yellow house. Tell them I sent you."
